errors.infrastructure: A service error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.archived: The class is archived and can no longer be changed.
errors.inviteCodeInvalid: This code is not valid. Please check it or ask the teacher for the current code.
errors.childAlreadyInClassroom: Your child is already in a class. Remove them from that class first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

validation.nameInvalid: Use a digit from 1 to 4 followed by one letter, for example “3b”.
validation.optionUnknown: Choose one of the available options.

create.nameHint: For example “3b”: a grade from 1 to 4 and one letter.
create.scopeNote: Hort.ai currently supports mathematics in Hessen.

join.title: Class
join.body: Enter the invite code from {name}’s teacher. Then {name} sees the class tasks under “School tasks”.
join.codeHint: For example ABCD-EFGH, as the teacher gave it to you.
join.leaveBody: {name} will no longer see this class’s tasks. You can join again with the teacher’s current code.

code.label: Invite code
code.copyFailed: Copying did not work. You can write the code down instead.

created.title: Class {name} is ready
created.share: Give this code to the parents of your class, for example in a letter home. They enter it on their home page so their child sees your assignments.

add.title: New class
add.description: Your assignments in the class you have selected stay as they are.

details.codeUnavailableHint: Only a one-way checksum is stored for this class, so nobody can show the old code again. You can generate a new one.
details.codeExpired: This code has expired. Generate a new one so more children can join.
details.regenerateBody: The current code stops working at once. Children who are already in the class stay in it.
